title: Structural MRI — CAT26 versus FreeSurfer on OpenNeuro ds000114
description: Portfolio project coordinating a descriptive structural MRI comparison between validated CAT26/SPM25 and FreeSurfer pipelines applied to the same OpenNeuro ds000114 T1-weighted image (sub-01, ses-test). The repository does not claim population inference or a completed region-by-region agreement analysis unless directly harmonized regional outputs are available.
notes: Cross-method single-subject portfolio project based on two separately validated source pipelines using the same public OpenNeuro ds000114 T1-weighted image. No population-level or diagnostic inference is claimed.
